description.value:
You gain better control of the eddies in the space around you, letting you find small shortcuts from place to place. For the duration of the spell, you gain the following abilities:

Flutter Step (1 action): You teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet.

Spatial Dodge (reaction, trigger: a creature targets you with an attack roll): Attempt a DC 11 flat check. On a success, you teleport 5 feet to an unoccupied space and the attack misses automatically. On a failure, the attack is resolved normally, then you teleport 5 feet.

Heightened (5th) Flutter Step increases to 15 feet, and Spatial Dodge increases to a 15-foot teleport. The flat check DC for Spatial Dodge decreases to 8.

Heightened (7th) Flutter Step increases to 30 feet. You can use Spatial Dodge twice per round. Once per round when you successfully dodge an attack with Spatial Dodge, you may Flutter Step as a free action immediately after.
